messages:
Maria Gomez: Postmortem follow-up: delayed usage ingestion on 3/10 caused ~2.1M token undercount and a small batch of invoice adjustments. Summary + action items below. I will coordinate. Who can own the ledger backfill and QA?
Ben Torres: I can own the ledger backfill. Estimate ~3 days. Will need a read window and a replay script. Tagging @Samir for infra help.
Samir Patel: infra ack. Will provision a larger ingest pod for the backfill and run the replay job. Need exact replay window + affected customer IDs.
Maria Gomez: Affected window = 2026-03-10T01:00Z -> 2026-03-10T09:30Z. FIN ticket created for invoice reissue (FIN-4821). I'll paste a sample customer list to the ticket.
Priya Rao: I will handle invoice reissues and customer comms. Draft email template in FIN-4830. SLA target: reissue within 7 business days after backfill validation.
Ben Torres: Backfill plan (high level): 1) snapshot ledger, 2) run replay locally with `scripts/replay_tokens.py --start ...`, 3) QA diff run, 4) apply to production ledger. I'll open a PR with script + runbook and link FIN-4822 to the PR.
Maria Gomez: Please include the replay SQL I/O limits in the runbook — we must avoid P95 latency regressions during replay.
Samir Patel: We'll enforce throttling via k8s autoscaler + resource caps. I'll add an `autoscalerOverride` param to the runbook and a safe default.
Priya Rao: Finance will hold invoice issuance until post-backfill reconciliation is done. Also need accounting adjustment entries ready.
Jordan Lee: Suggest adding an automated ingest-gap alert: if total tokens ingested drops >5% vs rolling baseline for 15m -> create an incident. I have a prototype that posts to #incidents (PR: devex/ingest-gap-alert).
Maria Gomez: Recap action owners & due dates: Ben - ledger backfill + scripts (due 2026-03-26), Samir - infra run + throttle params (due 2026-03-24), Priya - invoice comms (due 2026-03-29), Maria - update postmortem and close loop. Any blockers?
Ben Torres: :thumbsup: Starting now. Will post progress here.
Priya Rao: :eyes: I'll sync with CS for customer-facing copy.
ops-bot: Deployment check: backfill started by Ben Torres at 2026-03-21T14:12Z.
Ben Torres: Backfill run started; small snag with old schema — pushed a migration. Command I ran:
```
python scripts/replay_tokens.py --start 2026-03-10T01:00Z --end 2026-03-10T09:30Z --chunk-size 10000
```
Samir Patel: Seeing higher DB IOPS than expected; applied throttling param (autoscalerOverride=0.5). Monitor for 30m.
Ben Torres: QA diffs look good on sample of 100 customers. No unexpected deltas. Running full replay overnight.
Maria Gomez: Thanks — Priya please confirm when invoices are queued for reissue.
Priya Rao: Invoices queued for reissue; legal approved language, FIN-4830 updated with template. ETA invoices sent 2026-03-28.
Maria Gomez: I'll update the postmortem doc with timeline and mark action items closed after invoice send + ledger reconciliation.
Ben Torres: Note for follow-up automation: open ticket FIN-4860 to automate incremental replay triggers and backfill dry-run checks.
Jordan Lee: Will pick up the alerting PR after this incident.
Ben Torres: Backfill complete; reconciliation shows +2,140,312 tokens and ledger balanced. Closing FIN-4822 after production verification.
Maria Gomez: Closing note: recurring incident pattern detected — ingestion gaps aligned with a deprecated relay timeout. Added to the 'recurring patterns' section in the postmortem. Will schedule a retro with infra + devex next sprint. :spiral_calendar:
